title: TRANSDIFFERENTIATION OF PANCREATIC ACINAR CELLS
abstract_snippet: Induction of the neogenesis of b cells has been associated with the ductal epithelium, however 80% of the pancreas is composed of acinar cells. Surprisingly, pancreatic acinar cells contribute to the neogenesis of b cells. Partial duct obstruction (PDO) of the pancreas is a known inducer of b cell …
